text:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert: p99 tail latency spike detected for /v1/generate-stream. p99 = 3.4s, p95 = 460ms. Triggering page. AlertID=1988887777

sara: I'm awake. seeing streaming stalls and clients report long gaps between chunks (10-20s in some sessions). tagging @miguel @olivia @aj @kevin

miguel: checking node telemetry. gpupool-21 shows NVMe latency spikes and high blkio wait. GPU SM occupancy low (~30%). suspect noisy neighbor IO or large prefetch/checkpointing on same node.

olivia: can you map which pods are top writers? also check dmesg for blk_update_request warnings.

miguel: on gpupool-21: ran iostat & pidstat. found heavy writers: pod bulk-archive-gold-2 (tenant: goldco) doing sustained 120MB/s writes. dmesg shows repeated "blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1" spikes and queued requests.

miguel: quick commands used:
```
# iostat -x 1 3
Device:         r/s     w/s    rkB/s   wkB/s  await  svctm  %util
nvme0n1       250.0  800.0  51200.0 204800.0  45.2   0.60  99.9

# sudo pidstat -d 1 1 | sort -k7 -n -r | head -n 10 # shows pid 45121 (bulk-archive-gold-2) writing heavy
```

kevin: goldco runs nightly archival, normally on archive-only nodes. why is it on gpupool-21? cc @carol @ryan platform autoscaler?

carol: looks like autoscaler promoted a mixed node during scale-up; the node lost the "taint=archive-only:NoSchedule" label after a recent image bump. rolling back that patch now.

aj: mitigation options: 1) apply cgroup v2 io.max limits on the pod's slice temporarily, 2) cordon and drain gpupool-21 for new inference workloads, 3) move goldco job to archive nodes, 4) update route rules to avoid gpupool-21. I'll take 1+2.

miguel: for immediate throttle I recommend using cgroup v2 io.max on the container's scope. example: find the pod's containerd pid and update io.max:
```
# find container pid
$ ctr tasks ls --namespace k8s.io | grep bulk-archive-gold-2
# suppose PID=45121
# write limit: major:minor rbps wbps -> get device numbers from lsblk
$ echo "8:0 rbps=10485760 wbps=20971520" > /sys/fs/cgroup/io.slice/io.max
# or use systemd-run scope for quick action
```
Note: our cluster mixes cgroup v1/v2; I can apply systemd scope fallback if required.

olivia: please do the least disruptive throttle first to validate impact. keep us updated.

miguel: applied transient cgroup v2 io.max limit for the container's slice (10MB/s read, 20MB/s write). observed immediate drop in nvme utilization.

sara: seeing p99 drop from 3.4s -> 320ms within 40s. streaming stalls reduced, chunk gaps now within SLA. good quick mitigation.

aj: cordoned gpupool-21 and started evicting non-critical inference pods. added route policy to prevent new streaming sessions hitting the node. keeping one critical inference pod pinned for stability, draining others.

kevin: recreated bulk-archive-gold-2 with nodeSelector archive-node=true and tolerations removed so it lands on archive-disk-01. verified new pod on archive node and IO profile normal there.

miguel: capturing perf traces and blkio stats for postmortem: saved to s3://rbw-incidents/1988887777. colleting `perf top`, `iotop -o`, `dmesg` and `cat /proc/interrupts`.

carol: rolling back autoscaler image bump in staging now. will re-enable taint enforcement in CI to prevent untainted promotion.

devon: suggested long-term guardrails: admission controller to reject pods that request >50Mi ephemeral-storage or request direct-disk IO without batch label; also default container qos for background jobs to lower IO weight. filing RD-2100.

olivia: side note: some inference workers log show blocking on open/write when NVMe queue depth saturated. we should add kernel tracepoints around block layer to correlate when we see stalls again.

aj: handoff plan: I'll keep throttle for 30 minutes while eng-runtime verifies traces. then we'll migrate to container-level pod spec io limits via runtimeClass or cgroup config and remove transient cgroup v2 tweak. Monitoring window 90m.

sara: incident ticket INC-1988887777 created. severity SEV2. owners: eng-runtime, eng-sre, eng-platform. customer impact: goldco experienced degraded archival throughput (internal), 2 small customers saw streaming UX degradation. CS notified high-touch customers.

miguel: follow-ups created: RD-2101 (default io.max profile for background pods), RD-2102 (enforce node taints in autoscaler), RD-2103 (disk-saturation alert with node-level nvme latency >25ms triggering route failover).

kevin: validation: fio run on spare node reproduces queue saturation and inference stalls. adding synthetic load test to CI to ensure co-located writes don't exceed threshold.

carol: promoting autoscaler rollback to prod after 45m validation. also adding gating to image PRs that modify node labels.

incident-bot: Alert update: p99 for /v1/generate-stream within SLO. transition to monitoring. next check-in 10m.

sara: final - do not remove cgroup throttle until eng-runtime confirms artifacts collected. we will replace with pod-level limits. postmortem draft due EOD tomorrow. thanks all :heart:

aj: handoff ack. monitoring dashboard pinned: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/streams?incident=1988887777. contact list in thread. :thumbsup:
